quests.desc: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to make an effort to go to the south. Then, lift the berry from the floor of the dish-pit. Once that's all handled, you can stop!

infos.name: scullery
infos.desc:
Of every scullery you could have shown up in, you had to come round an ordinary one. You decide to just list off a complete list of everything you see in the room, because hey, why not?

 You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a fridge.[if c_0 is open and there is something in the c_0] The fridge contains [a list of things in the c_0]. Hmmm... what else, what else?[end if][if c_0 is open and the c_0 contains nothing] The fridge is empty! What a waste of a day![end if] Were you looking for a board? Because look over there, it's a board. You shudder, but continue examining the board. The board is ordinary.[if there is something on the s_0] On the board you make out [a list of things on the s_0].[end if][if there is nothing on the s_0] But the thing is empty, unfortunately. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the board.[end if]

 There is [if d_3 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] gateway leading east. There is [if d_0 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] door leading west. You need an unblocked exit? You should try going south.

infos.name: office
infos.desc:
If you're wondering why everything seems so typical all of a sudden, it's because you've just sauntered into the office. You decide to just list off a complete list of everything you see in the room, because hey, why not?

 You see a desk. [if there is something on the s_1]On the desk you can see [a list of things on the s_1]. Something scurries by right in the corner of your eye. Probably nothing.[end if][if there is nothing on the s_1]But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of trash. Aw, here you were, all excited for there to be things on it![end if]

 There is [if d_0 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] door leading east. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unblocked. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unguarded.

infos.name: kitchen
infos.desc:
You're now in a kitchen.



 There is [if d_2 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] gate leading north. There is [if d_3 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] gateway leading west.

infos.name: shower
infos.desc:
You've entered a shower.

 You smell a hideous smell, and follow it to a cabinet.[if c_1 is open and there is something in the c_1] The cabinet contains [a list of things in the c_1]. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best?[end if][if c_1 is open and the c_1 contains nothing] The cabinet is empty, what a horrible day![end if]

 There is [if d_1 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] hatch leading east. There is [if d_2 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] gate leading south. There is an unblocked exit to the west.

infos.name: restroom
infos.desc:
You've entered a restroom.

 You see a counter. [if there is something on the s_2]You see [a list of things on the s_2] on the counter.[end if][if there is nothing on the s_2]But there isn't a thing on it. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?[end if] You can make out a bench. [if there is something on the s_3]You see [a list of things on the s_3] on the bench.[end if][if there is nothing on the s_3]But there isn't a thing on it. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the bench.[end if]

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going east.

infos.name: studio
infos.desc:
You've entered a studio.



 There is [if d_1 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] hatch leading west. There is an unguarded exit to the south.

infos.name: laundromat
infos.desc:
Ah, the laundromat. This is some kind of laundromat, really great usual vibes in this place, a wonderful usual atmosphere.

 You make out a drawer.[if c_2 is open and there is something in the c_2] The drawer contains [a list of things in the c_2].[end if][if c_2 is open and the c_2 contains nothing] The drawer is empty! This is the worst thing that could possibly happen, ever![end if]

There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unguarded. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unblocked.

infos.name: dish-pit
infos.desc:
You are in a dish-pit. An ordinary one. You try to gain information on your surroundings by using a technique you call 'looking.'



You need an unguarded exit? You should try going east. There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unguarded.

infos.name: kitchenette
infos.desc:
You are in a kitchenette. An ordinary one. I guess you better just go and list everything you see here.

 Oh wow! Is that what I think it is? It is! It's a pan. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? [if there is something on the s_4]You see [a list of things on the s_4] on the pan.[end if][if there is nothing on the s_4]But there isn't a thing on it. What, you think everything in TextWorld should have stuff on it?[end if] You make out a saucepan. The saucepan is typical.[if there is something on the s_5] On the saucepan you can make out [a list of things on the s_5].[end if][if there is nothing on the s_5] But the thing is empty.[end if]

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going north.

infos.name: closet
infos.desc:
You find yourself in a closet. A typical one. You try to gain information on your surroundings by using a technique you call 'looking.'

 You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a locker. Now that's what I call TextWorld![if c_3 is open and there is something in the c_3] The locker contains [a list of things in the c_3].[end if][if c_3 is open and the c_3 contains nothing] The locker is empty! This is the worst thing that could possibly happen, ever![end if]

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going south.
